items.question: What is the derivative of x^2 sin x, and what is its integral? Show the steps.
items.expected: d/dx = 2x sin x + x^2 cos x; ∫ = -x^2 cos x + 2x sin x + 2cos x + C

items.question: Why doesn't the International Space Station fall down if gravity up there is still about 90% as strong as on the ground?
items.expected: It is falling: orbital velocity ~7.7 km/s means it falls around the Earth (free fall), hence weightlessness.

items.question: In a transformer, why do we divide the attention scores by the square root of the key dimension?
items.expected: Dot products of random d-dim vectors have variance ~d; scaling keeps softmax out of saturation (small gradients).
